conclusions.rationale: The bound assertion requires zero violations across every repository command contract compiled with --auto. The helper checks at most 10 required tasks with contiguous ordinals, the outcome.verified/archive.run tail, that required tasks belong to receipt families or typed execution/review evidence, that only outcome.verified demands observable_output_or_artifact, a stop-condition argv starting with livespec and a display string derived from it, schema 3.0 in both payload and rendered contract, and a contract checklist equal to the active execution-task plus definition-of-done inventory. This verifies every conjunct of AC-001. Residual: the checklist is compared with the same compiled payload inventory, so a compile step that drops inventory rows would not be detected.

The real-subprocess test (stop_condition_exit_zero on an invalid spec) and the launch-failure test (exit 127 with the error text) back it. This verifies AC-002.
